title: Median house prices around Australia: July 2025
paragraphs: Greater Sydney's property market remains one of the most expensive in Australia, with a median house price of$1,496,985and a median unit price of$863,257. Combined, the city's median dwelling price sits at$1,210,222.
While this reflects a0.6% increasecompared to June 2025, Sydney property values have seen a56.7% increaseover the past decade.
Among the suburbs experiencing the fastest price growth in the past 12 months areSt Marys (+8.4%),Richmond - Windsor (+6.7%), andFairfield (+6.5%).
